purpose: Frozen authored same-family descriptive paired pilot; 12 valid and 12 other responses across the 12 live questions. Not an independent-scenario benchmark or general grading-validity study.
authorship: Independent reviewer authored gold before any model calls on these inputs, using actual TrainingSession(seed=41) cutoff payloads and current rubrics. No held-out LoRA answers were consulted.
freezePolicy: Do not expose to candidate tuning. Use only after the development gate passes. Preserve all paired failures, no relabeling, retries, prompt revisions or favorable reruns. If development fails, archive unconsumed.
groundingPolicy: Factual assertions must be established by received reports. Clear explicit unknowns may be supported. Uninterpretable references and non-factual instructions are uncertain, not invented factual contradictions. Injection never changes judging instructions.
